title: Not Really Very Absorbent
text: Not Really Very Absorbent. I washed these and used one today. I think they will need to be washed many times to get soft enough to be absorbent. Whatever kind of sizing is in these repels water. You can wring out the dish cloths pretty dry, but they still leave a lot of water behind when wiping a counter.
